Thanks for the ping. A few practical notes from Marketplace & Co-sell: 

- Co-sell / referral: AWS prefers a clear arrangement in writing. For private offers where we ask AWS to co-sell, typical take rates we've agreed to in the past are in the 12-20% band. For Acme I'd recommend opening at 18% conditional on a minimum ARR expectation (we can draft a clause: "co-sell referral fee: 18% of net revenue booked through the private offer, payable to AWS partner team").

- Marketplace fees: AWS charges their marketplace fee on top of the listed price; do not double-count in our suggested discounts. We should model net-to-Redwood after AWS fee and the co-sell percentage.

- Terming & pricing: offer a 6-8% list discount for 24 months, 12%+ for multi-year (36+ months) if they commit to an annualized minimum. Keep 12 months as our standard commercial baseline with smaller or no term discount. This approach preserves price integrity for shorter deals and rewards longer commitments.

- Approval lane: for deals <= $150k ARR equivalent we can approve via sales ops. Anything above $150k or with a nonstandard co-sell arrangement (discount >10% or nonstandard clause) needs VP sign-off (Jordan) and legal review.

I'll attach a sample clause and a short one-pager for procurement. Rafael — I added suggested wording to the attached draft.

- Vanessa

Adding sales ops perspective:

- Approval thresholds (recommended):
  * <= $50k ARR equivalent: SDR/AE can approve and submit private offer via marketplace ops template.
  * $50k - $150k: requires sales ops sign-off (email ok), document recorded in HubSpot and shared Drive.
  * > $150k or discount >10% or co-sell fee >18%: requires VP+legal approvals and explicit DocuSign signature by finance.

- Billing cadence: recommend Acme stay on annual prepaid billing for term discount to avoid long-tail collections. If they insist on monthly, we reduce term discount by 2-3 points.

- Attachments: I've included a simple spreadsheet (PO_Term_Scenarios.xlsx) modeling list price vs net-to-Redwood for 12/24/36 month scenarios including AWS marketplace fee (assumed 12%) and co-sell at 18%. Rafael — see tab "Acme-scenarios".

Hi Sarah / Tom — thanks for the patience. Internal guidance below summarizes our recommended structure and next steps; I've attached the draft clause and a short scenario workbook.

Summary recommendation
- Standard term: 12 months (list price).
- Incentive for longer-term: 24 months = 6-8% list discount; 36+ months = 12% list discount with minimum annualized ARR commitment.
- AWS co-sell referral: recommend 18% of net revenue in this private offer (we'll pass that to AWS partner team). If Acme provides strong pipeline coverage or a higher ARR commitment we can discuss lowering to 15% as a concession.
- Approval gating: based on Marcus' thresholds; your deal looks likely in the $75k-$120k band so it will require Sales Ops sign-off (Marcus) but not VP sign-off unless discount or co-sell deviates from the above.
- Billing: annual prepaid recommended to realize the term discount. Monthly billing reduces the discount 2-3 pts.

Next steps
1) Tom — please confirm if annual prepaid is acceptable.
2) Sarah — if you want, I can submit the private offer draft to AWS Marketplace ops (cc'ed) once you confirm the term and billing cadence.
3) We'll route for Sales Ops sign-off and produce the final private-offer doc for your procurement team.

Attachments: proposed-amz-private-offer-draft.pdf, PO_Term_Scenarios.xlsx

Best,
